But in the 500s, raiders called the Huna swept in from Central Asia.
In the south, though, the story was just getting started.
The Chola Kings of Tamil Nadu built one of the greatest navies in Asian history.
Rajaraja I built the vast Brihadishwara temple at Thanjavur, finished around 1010. Its tower
is about 66 meters tall. His son, Rajendra, sent his fleet across the Bay of Bengal to
attack the mighty Srivijaya kingdom in Sumatra and Malaya.
Looking at a map. An Indian navy, raiding Southeast Asia. A thousand years ago. But in the north,
things were about to change. A powerful Sultan had just learned how rich India's temples were.
